audit.whatIsWrong: Sky Splitter (E) is described three times as 'a long-range airborne stun that interrupts your R channel'. It is not a stun and it does not knock up. Thundering Smash (Q) is also called a 'dash' — it is a movement-speed charge, not a dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: E 'summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius' (1200 range, 16s flat). Q 'gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' (300 range, 12s at rank 1, auto-attack reset). The only dash in the kit is Stormbringer (R), which also disables nearby enemy towers.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter = 1200-range slow plus a self-shield he only gets inside the blast; Thundering Smash = the stun, on an auto reset; Stormbringer = the leap that turns off your tower.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven level rows disagree with the packet chart and with the matchup's own prose — Level 1 is marked Kennen while whys[0] says it is even, levels 2/3, 6 and first item are 'Skill' while the prose says Kennen owns them, and 2+ items is Kennen while both late-game paragraphs say Volibear reclaims the lane.
audit.why: Kennen's Q reaches 950 and Volibear must close to 300-325 for Thundering Smash and Frenzied Maul, so 2-3 and 6 are clearly Kennen. Past two items Frenzied Maul's per-cast heal plus HP and armour out-last a 120s ultimate.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Skill, Level 2 = Kennen, Level 3 = Kennen, Level 6 = Kennen, First item = Kennen, 2+ items = Volibear.

audit.why: Kennen's spikes at 2-3, 6 and first item are accurate. Volibear's spikes are Frenzied Maul rank-ups (flat 5s cooldown), and Stormbringer at 160/135/110s, which disables the tower and makes his level-6 dive free.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is in the item list but never tied to a fight decision.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul heals him on the second cast into the same target on a flat 5s cooldown, so extended trades are decided by Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named as a precondition for the level-6 commit.

notes: Corrected a repeated fabrication: Sky Splitter (E) was written as an airborne stun that interrupts Kennen's R. Riot's text gives it damage, a slow and a self-shield only — no CC. Thundering Smash is the stun and Stormbringer the only dash. Level chart rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic group across both layers. Whether Slicing Maelstrom's damage ticks continue through Stormbringer's leap is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
